title: Copilot Notebooks: audio overview gains topic episodes, Critique and Debate formats and label support
summary: The briefing incorrectly says no source describes changes to existing Notebooks behaviour: the roadmap explicitly changes audio overview navigation, formats and content coverage. Remove that planning premise and reconsider the review rating for an update to an existing experience. The controls are supported, while the label-inheritance caveat should acknowledge conflicting Microsoft guidance.
